title: Hetunā bāhira
text: 3 Rūpā bhikkhave dukkhā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rupānam uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtā bhikkhave rūpā kuto sukhā bhavissanti || || 4-7 Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || 8 Dhammā dukkhā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo dhammānam uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtā bhikkhave dhammā kuto sukhā bhavissanti || || 9 Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
